en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a quiet riverside harbor with small sailboats and houses reflected in the water. Trees and low hills form the background. The caption printed below the image reads "PADRÓN — Muelle de Puente Cesures." The lower and right margins are filled with handwritten correspondence. At the bottom right is a printer's credit, "Fotgl. Ferrer: Coruña," and at the very bottom, a commercial line for "Comercio de Manuel Suarez Castro."
